one_liner: A work OS and project management platform to track tasks, workflows, and team collaboration.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 and personal V2 API tokens passed in the Authorization header.
access_notes: You can sign up for a free developer account to get API tokens and test at no cost.
api_notes: GraphQL API covering boards, items, column values, users, workspaces, and more.
blocker_notes: Public documentation, GraphQL API, and free developer accounts make it immediately buildable.

auth.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.

access.quote: If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.

api.quote: The monday GraphQL API is part of the monday apps framework. It is an application layer that allows apps to read and update data inside a monday.com account. It supports operations boards, items, column values, users, workspaces, and more.

mcp.quote: The monday.com hosted MCP server lets you interact with your monday.com account through natural language — create items, query boards, build dashboards, and more — from your preferred AI platform. Server URL: https://mcp.monday.com/mcp

verdict.quote: If you don't have a monday.com account yet, create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
